page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre "IVDAICO." with page number "34" at top right. Below: centred heading "TABELLA" and title "Cyclorum Lunarium à principio annorum Christi ad nostra tempora." Then a table in two parallel blocks of three columns each (Anno Christi currente / Anni Iudaici absoluti / Cycli absoluti), left block then right block. Below the table, one paragraph of running text. Catchword-like word "Canon" at lower right and signature-like "CAP. V." at lower left, both below the text.

main_text.head: TABELLA Cyclorum Lunarium à principio annorum Christi ad nostra tempora.
main_text.l: Anno Christi currente. | ANNI Iudaici absoluti. | Cycli absoluti. | ANNI Indaici absoluti. | Cycli absoluti. | Anno Christi currente.
main_text.p: Priusquam ad Iudæorum abacum Lunarem procedamus, visum fuit tabellam præmittere sive Canonem, cujus solo inspectu, horarum partes sexagesimæ primæ, secundæ & tertiæ convertuntur in Helakim Iudeorum. Octodecim Helakim æquipollent uni sexagesimæ. Quare tabella ista constructa est per continuam additionem numeri 18. Rursus unum Helak valet sec. 3. tert. 20. cujus numeri continua collectione absolvitur tabella minor usq; ad Helakim 18.

page.notes: Table is printed in two parallel blocks; the column headings of the right block read "ANNI Indaici absoluti" (sic). Some faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. The signature "CAP. V." at lower left is faint and partly illegible. The word "Canon" at lower right is a catchword-style word. Cell values of the table are reproduced in line order, with the left block's Anno Christi column shown first.
